difficulty_reason: The lemma records that etaleness is preserved by base change. The proof invokes the fact established in the characterisation of etale morphisms, that being etale is a property of ring maps which is local in the sense of the general machinery for morphism properties, and then applies the general lemma that converts such a local ring-map property stable under base change into stability of the corresponding morphism property under base change, the stability of the ring-map property being the algebra lemma on etale ring maps.
